relationships.subject: minor cannabinoids
relationships.evidence_quote: All the cannabinoids tested here inhibited TRPV1 signalling.

relationships.subject: cannabichromene
relationships.evidence_quote: the K+ channel inhibitor tertiapin Q reversed the inhibitory effects of CBC and restored Ca2+ influx immediately after applying capsaicin, indicating that CBC had the effect of K+ channel activation

relationships.subject: tertiapin Q
relationships.evidence_quote: Tertiapin Q is a peptide derived from honeybee venom, that blocks GIRK channels

relationships.subject: tetrahydrocannabiorcol
relationships.evidence_quote: This finding agrees with previous reports of THCC eliciting Ca2+ influx, by activating the noxious sensor TRPA1 in DRG neurons at high micromolar concentrations.

key_findings: All ten minor cannabinoids inhibited capsaicin-evoked Ca2+ influx in sensitized rat DRG neurons, completely in 35-78% of capsaicin-sensitive neurons, comparably to morphine and gabapentin.
CBC inhibition was reversed by tertiapin Q, indicating K+ channel activation; THCC and CBN elicited Ca2+ influx at high doses.
